🤖 The Zombot — Boss Machine
Dr. Zomboss is the main antagonist. He pilots the Zombot — a colossal robot — in Level 5-10. The Zombot fills the entire right side of the screen and attacks relentlessly with alternating fireball and iceball patterns while dropping zombie reinforcements onto the grid.

🔥 Attack Patterns
🔥 Fireball — Destroys all plants in a wide area instantly.
❄️ Iceball — Freezes all plants in a 3×3 zone.
🧟 Zombie Drop — Releases reinforcements directly on the grid.
⛑️ Catapult Zombies — Vehicles lobbing basketballs along full lanes.
✅ How to Defeat Dr. Zomboss
1Cattails — auto-track Zombot across all lanes.
2Winter Melons — slow and damage simultaneously.
3Sunflowers in back rows — steady sun supply.
4Hit the Zombot head when it bends to attack.
5Tall-nuts to block dropped zombie reinforcements.
🏆 After Defeating Zomboss...
The Zombot explodes. Dr. Zomboss flees. Victory cutscene plays. New modes unlock: Puzzle (I, Zombie), Survival, Zen Garden. Adventure Mode 100% complete.

💻 Software Engineering Architecture
💰 Resource Economy
Real-time sun generation + spending. Sunflower = passive income generator. Player manages a dynamic budget every second.
🌊 Lane Combat Engine
5 parallel lanes with independent targeting, projectile physics, and damage calculation running simultaneously.
🔄 Entity State Machine
Every entity has its own state. Newspaper Zombie = event-triggered transition. Chomper = chewing state + vulnerability flag.
🌊 Wave Spawner
Procedural wave generation scaling difficulty. Dr. Zomboss = finite state machine with randomized attack outputs.
